recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not edit current Medication source for FHIR-7601; future medication dose-form terminology changes should start from the FHIR-19296/736542009 history rather than the DSTU1 route-code correction.
issue_request: FHIR-7601 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Pharmacy correction asking that wording/binding around the Medication resource use the appropriate SNOMED CT concept. Although the ballot text and related URL are ambiguous, the final resolution explicitly says to update the Medication Resource binding for medication.product.form to include SNOMED CT codes where concept is-a 421967003 rather than the route-of-administration parent.
initial_application: The Jira comment says this was fixed in svn 6615. The matching git-svn commit c74b8e3ebbf92ccc157a591a1571158559a655cd changed source/medication/valueset-medication-form-codes.xml from SNOMED CT 284009009 to 421967003 for the Medication.form value-set expansion fix. That matches the FHIR-7601 resolution family, even though the commit subject did not enumerate every duplicate-family Jira key.
additional_context: Medication is still active in source/fhir.ini, and the old Medication.form/medication.product.form surface is now Medication.doseForm. Current Medication.doseForm binds to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/medication-form-codes, whose source uses SNOMED CT 736542009. Later Published/Persuasive FHIR-19296 deliberately changed the medication form parent from 421967003 to 736542009 and is already represented on the combined branch. The FHIR-7601 related URL points at the old package-form page, but the accepted resolution text targets medication.product.form; the separate package-form family already corrected its package-form value set to SNOMED CT 408102007.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current active Medication source is not bound to the route-of-administration parent reported by the issue, and changing it back to 421967003 would undo the later FHIR-19296 Pharmacy decision.
